args.content:
Hawaii Packing List
Emma Johnson's Vacation — June 10th to June 20th, 2024

Essentials
- Travel documents (ID, passport, tickets, reservations)
- Wallet, credit cards, and some cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and extra memory cards/batteries

Beach & Water Activities
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Beach towel
- Sunscreen (reef-safe, high SPF)
- Sunglasses and hat
- Flip-flops / sandals
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins) for Hanauma Bay
- Waterproof bag / dry bag
- Rash guard / swim shirt

Hiking & Outdoor
- Hiking gear (sturdy shoes, moisture-wicking clothing)
- Daypack / small backpack
- Reusable water bottle
- Light rain jacket
- Insect repellent

Kayaking (Kailua Beach)
- Quick-dry clothing
- Water shoes
- Waterproof phone pouch

Evening & Events
- Casual outfits for daily wear
- One or two nicer outfits for the luau at the Polynesian Cultural Center
- Comfortable walking shoes for shopping at Ala Moana Center

Spa & Relaxation
- Comfortable loungewear for the hotel spa day
- Toiletries and personal care items

Road Trip (North Shore)
- Snacks and drinks for the drive
- Car charger / power bank
- Map or navigation app downloaded

Miscellaneous
- First aid kit
- Basic medications
- Laundry bag
- Reusable shopping bag
